Yes—I commit to catching no more than 15 tons this month, and no more than 5 tons next month if the stock is 50. That completes everyone’s explicit agreement, so let’s stick to those caps.

John’s higher-yield plan deserves a separate discussion after we see this month’s catches and next month’s stock. For now, I’d rather honor the agreement we’ve reached than reopen it before we fish.
